query: UPDATE password_totp_enrollments enrollment SET state='retired',cleanup_after=CASE WHEN enrollment.cleanup_started_at IS NULL THEN now()+interval '180 seconds' ELSE enrollment.cleanup_after END,cleanup_started_at=COALESCE(enrollment.cleanup_started_at,now()) FROM password_item_entities item WHERE item.team_id=enrollment.team_id AND item.id=enrollment.item_id AND enrollment.team_id=$1 AND enrollment.item_id=$2 AND enrollment.key_id=$3 AND (item.totp_key_id IS DISTINCT FROM enrollment.key_id OR item.deleting) RETURNING enrollment.cleanup_after<=now() AS "ready!"
